senses.gloss: m. pl. (preced.; cmp. הַדְרָאָה) flour of the second course, bran-flour (differ. fr. מוּרְסָן).
units: <cite ref="Ketubot 112a:11">Keth. 112ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:9">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite>, a. e.—

<cite ref="Bava Batra 98b:6">B. Bath. 98ᵇ</cite> (from Ben Sira) <he>הכל … קל מס׳ וקל מס׳ וכ׳</he> I have weighed everything …, and found nothing lighter than bran, but lighter (in mind) than bran is &c.; a. fr.—Sing. <cite ref="O00228"><he>סוֹב</he></cite>, with suffix <he>סוּבָּן</he>.
